notes.title: Give me your feedback!
notes.content:
I noticed there were still people buying and playing this game, so I thought it might be a good idea to add a feedback form to this game too, like in my second game. If there is anything bothering you, you can tell me directly now. Don't be shy

While at it, I also updated the engine, which was a larger change to the whole game. I hope it didn't break anything major. At least you can tell me about any bugs now. And I thank my past self for doing the majority of the work, so I just have to fix some smaller things. Good job past me!

notes.title: v1.1.0 - User Level Editor
notes.content:
Since many of you have finished the game so fast, I decided to make my level editor public for you to create your own levels. So now you can challenge yourself to create levels for other players to beat. I am excited to play your levels! Hopefully they are not too difficult for me..

[h2]Changelog:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Add User Level Editor
[*] Play Levels from Workshop
[*] Add Steam Status Icon and error notification
[/list]

notes.title: v1.0.1 - Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[h1]Fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Finish achievement couldn't be unlocked when you finished the game with full stars.
[*] Color switch didn't work properly at laser intersections. It should make some levels more difficult.
[/list]

[h1]Changes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Updated level 7 and 14 to make it not too easy
[*] Added new achievements for beating my best score since it is clearly possible.
[/list]
